en: “Hey, what's wrong?”
“Let me know if you have any questions!”
“I feel like you're avoiding me. Am I imagining things?”
“Hey, do you have some time later?”
“About me attacking you at night... I kinda felt bad about it afterward... Are you mad?”
“Hey, remember to relax sometimes.”
“Hehe... I like it when you act this way~”
“I look forward to today's snacks!”
“I feel like I'm getting fat recently—”
“I don't want kids... They're just cute sometimes...”
“Hm... I feel like something happened but I can't remember.
Eh? Why are you blushing?”
“I stopped working after coming here. It took some time to get used to.”
“You can't sing to others anymore... If you want to practice, just come find me...”
“Hmm... I'm fine—It just stirred a little something in me...”
“Yay—I hope you're looking forward to it. I'll plan everything next time!”
“Yeah—What? What's that face? I can't hug you?”
“Let's go on a date somewhere else next time—!”
“Can I... come to your room tonight?”
“Ah—It's nothing. I'm just happy to see you!”
“I want to get to know you. You can tell me anything!”
“My thoughts are a mess...”
“There are things I want to say, but I don't know how...”
“I've been feeling restless today. Maybe it's the heat?”
“Ah... I can't hold it any longer. Come to my room...”
“Oh... I'm feeling a little hot after seeing you. What should we do...?”
“W-Wait... Stay with me. Don't go...”
“Being like this outside is actually quite exciting...”
“No one's seen me like that, besides you~♡”
“I can't be seen like this—”
